Silver Coast Construction & Boring began in Abu Dhabi in 1997, with Mahdarbashee among its co-founding partners. He has served in executive leadership as the contractor expanded across buildings, steel structures, civil engineering, mechanical and electrical works, fabrication and facilities management.
